title: Floreláis
description: Created in 1 week for my high school art class. It is a very basic mod adding 6 flowers and a boss. Similar feel as old 1.7.10 mods.
body:
![Mod Thumbnail which shows the 6 flowers added by Floreláis and the boss, Guardian of the Gardens inside of a Mangrove Swamp during the day.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XgrJoyx0/images/350b612f5ae1bde77f194a1ff7a98b5dcbdeecc6.png)

6 new flowers to the game and a custom boss called the "Guardian of the Gardens", found in Mangrove Swamps after being summoned from the altar.

This mod is a basic mod I created in 1 week for my high school art class assignment, "Digital Portfolio".

SPOILER:
All flowers can be crafted into their respective color dyes.
Chrysaliflower and Cherryflower have thorns which damage the player.
Guardian of The Gardens has 400 hp, 10 armor points, does 17 damage per hit, and is immune to knockback not dealt by explosions. Makes leafy noises when hit. He also breaks through any mangrove swamp related blocks in his way while attempting to get to the player.
